name: thebe_v3_anchor75_stratified
goal: More training windows containing valid positive fault labels, with sparse positives retained and background exposure preserved
random: Original v3-U origin draw and support acceptance; no positive-label rejection
anchor_source: Only supervised valid positive labels in train
spatial_balance: Choose occupied spatial cells before positive coordinates; monitor coverage and duplicates; not fault-instance balance
augmentation_randomness: Independent deterministic RNG from sampling; shared epoch plan across all model controls
ddp: Precompute 300 grouped effective batches; randomize slots inside each group; no second global shuffle that destroys quotas
boundary: Prefer fully contained windows; masked same-split padding permitted to anchor edge positives; never read another split
sparse_pool_shortage: Record any explicit fallback to regular foreground, actual quotas, and coverage; no silent repetition or unbounded rejection
loss_and_augmentation: Keep current masked Dice+Focal over 128^3 and existing augmentations
validation_test: Unchanged spatial-v3 exhaustive valid support; no foreground filtering
required_offline_audit: One complete 2400-window epoch plus deterministic DDP allocation, coverage and throughput checks
